name: Aera shan Ravanór
summary: A party member and skilled archer whose tooth necklace led the group through the mists to Barovia.

facts.text: Her tooth necklace levitated and pulled the party into the mists out of Daggerford.
Found a red book that opened a hidden door behind the office bookshelf in Durst Manor.
Rose Durst's spirit joined with her body.
Killed the creature in the manor basement, two ghouls, a mimic and the boneless, and cut off Walter's head.
Found a guide to killing vampires in the burgomaster's mansion.
Pilfered two healing potions from an overpriced shop in Barovia village.
Madam Eva asked her to deliver 10 gold to Blinsky's toy shop to buy something for her grandchild Arabelle.
Bought a wolf pelt from Szoldar that turned out to be glamour weave.

name: Weeble Wobleston
summary: A party member whose glowing pendant led the group through the mists.

facts.text: His pendant glowed and hovered toward the barn wall, leading the party into the mists.
Destroyed an animated broom on the third floor of Durst Manor.
Promised Rose to bury the Durst children's bones in the garden.
Was attacked by a mimic and a boneless in the manor basement, and was given first rights to the footlocker loot.
Found a compass on a dead young man's body on the road into Barovia.
Nearly provoked Strahd and cast Sleep on an injured bird.
Cast Sleep on a bandit leader during a fight over a road toll.

name: Schlopkht
summary: A sneaky party member who often scouts ahead and tries clever ruses.

facts.text: Moved the snarling stuffed wolf and found Lady Fiona Wachter's invitation in a coat closet.
Broke a mirror after seeing Elisabeth Durst's apparition and kept a shard; was knocked out by the creature in the basement.
Raised the portcullis and broke a window so the party could escape the collapsing manor.
Scouted through the looping fog on a rope to find the fourth marked tree.
Volunteered to return the sunburst relic to Father Donavich.
Tried to bribe the Vallaki guards with dream pies.
Staged a fall to reveal the signet ring to Victor.

name: Olfin Darning
summary: A Hexblood party member who heals with laying on of hands.

facts.text: Found a teapot with wine, lace and a contraceptive powder in the Durst Manor pantry.
Was knocked out by an animated broom.
Thorn Durst's spirit joined with his body.
Recovered Ireena's keepsakes and was given a silver bracelet inscribed Tatyana; noticed bite marks on her neck.
Healed an injured bird and tied a lock of his hair to its leg.
Told a lie about being raised by hags and read Van Richten's werewolf manuscript aloud.
Used the signet ring's pattern to unlock the Tower of Khazan.

name: Malron Lichtstrahl
summary: A cleric of Lathander in the party and author of several log entries.

facts.text: Found a book titled 'Tale of Malron' telling his own life story in Durst Manor.
Convinced Gustav Durst's ghost to let the party escape the manor.
Staked the vampire beneath the church, believed to be Doru.
Was blessed by Father Donavich with the 'Strength of a new dawn'.
Sneaked upstairs in the Baron's mansion and found a book of Vallaki births and deaths.
Cured Gumbo of lycanthropy with a Remove Curse scroll and received the Talisman of Echoes from Rictavio.

name: Grom Shield-Breaker
summary: A confrontational dwarf in the party.

facts.text: Introduced as the party's dwarf, said to have always been with them.
Challenged the hidden scouts on the road to Tser Pool.
Carries a tooth, as does each member of his family.
Won the Vistani storytelling game and its prizes.

name: Shabasta
summary: A porcupine-like bard met at the Vistani encampment who travels with the party.

facts.text: Met at the Vistani encampment near Vallaki, telling tales and playing a lute.
Found wolf tracks and a hollow full of paint near the wagon at the Tower of Khazan.
Triggered a silver net and fire potions in Ezmerelda's wagon.
Performed at the Blue Water Inn for a bed and beer.

name: Gumbo
summary: A half-orc rogue with the party who was bitten by a werewolf.

facts.text: Got a festering werewolf bite and was cured of lycanthropy by Malron's Remove Curse scroll.

name: Liren
summary: A golden dragonborn barbarian with a great axe met at the Blue Water Inn.

facts.text: Met by the party at the Blue Water Inn.

name: Rose Durst
summary: The ghostly daughter of Gustav and Elisabeth Durst, tied to Durst Manor.

facts.text: Met outside the manor with her brother Thorn; afraid to go inside.
Her skeleton was found locked in the attic with Thorn's; she showed the party a secret stair to the basement.
Her spirit joined with Aera.
Her power let Aera make a rock glow and cast Mend.
Her remains were buried near the tower.

name: Thorn Durst
summary: The ghostly son of Gustav and Elisabeth Durst, tied to Durst Manor.

facts.text: Thought he heard noises from below the manor.
His spirit joined with Olfin.
His remains were buried near the tower.

name: Gustav Durst
summary: Father of the Durst family who had an affair with the nursemaid Klara.

facts.text: Rose named her parents as Gustav and Elisabeth.
Seen as an apparition dancing with Klara in the ballroom.
The creature that attacked from the bones appeared to be his remains.
His ghost let the party escape after Malron's plea.

name: Elisabeth Durst
summary: Mother of the Durst family, a cultist servant of Strahd.

facts.text: Seen as an apparition glaring at Gustav and Klara, her amber shard flashing.
Left a note naming Drasha the Beast's custodian with an amber shard.
Strahd's letter to her led the party to think she was the monster.
Her apparition vowed to kill the party for destroying her pet.

name: Walter Durst
summary: Klara's son by Gustav, an undead baby inside the flesh mound beneath Durst Manor.

facts.text: His name was carved into the headrest of a crib.
Was Klara's son; the cult fed victims to him.
Found undead inside a flesh mound; Aera cut off his head.

name: Klara
summary: The Durst children's nursemaid, who had Gustav's child.

facts.text: Left a note asking leave because of her condition.
Seen as an apparition dancing with Gustav.
Her tortured apparition appeared in a third floor mirror.
Walter was her son.

name: Drasha
summary: A servant chosen by Elisabeth Durst as the Beast's custodian.

facts.text: Elisabeth left her a note and an amber shard to soothe the Beast.
An invitation to the Durst Mill anniversary, addressed to her, fell from a coat in Durst Manor.

name: Strahd von Zarovich
summary: The vampire lord of Barovia.

facts.text: Wrote a scornful letter to Elisabeth Durst.
His forces besieged Barovia village; Ismark warned of his spies.
Bit and controlled Ireena in the past.
Met the party on the road with seven dire wolves and let Ireena stay with them for now.
Fears Madam Eva because she can see the future.
Crushed the Dusk Elves' revolt after his father died.
Put a bounty on dark-haired, olive-skinned girls with lavender irises.

name: Ireena Kolyana
summary: Ismark's adopted sister, whom the party escorts to sanctuary.

facts.text: Ismark's adopted sister, found in the forest as a little girl.
Has two bite marks from Strahd; gave Olfin a silver bracelet.
Strahd called out to her on the road but let her stay with the party.
Told a tale of a wolf by a lake that she claimed was a dream.
Was enraged by the refugee camp and the Baron's callousness.
A doll resembling her was seen in Blinsky's toy store.
Escorted to St. Andral's Church, where Father Lucian offered her shelter.

name: Ismark
summary: Ireena's brother and grandson of Ismark Antonovich the Great, in Barovia village.

facts.text: Met at the Blood on the Vine Tavern; asked the party to help his sister.
His father died in the attack on the village.
Asked the party to escort Ireena to the Abbey of Saint Markovia in Krezk.

name: Ismark Antonovich the Great
summary: A past burgomaster of Barovia honored with a statue.

facts.text: His statue's plaque calls him Burgomaster of Barovia and Bane of Vampires.

name: Bildrath
summary: A man in the Blood on the Vine Tavern who scorned Ismark.

facts.text: Called Ismark's mission a fool's errand.

name: Gertruda
summary: A girl from Barovia village who left alone for Vallaki at night.

facts.text: Reported missing in the tavern; Ismark promised to send someone.

name: Father Donavich
summary: The priest of the Morninglord at Barovia village's church, father of Doru.

facts.text: His son Doru led a party to the castle.
Lost his Bronze Sunburst and trapped vampire Doru beneath the church.
Performed burial rites for Ismark's father and blessed Malron.

name: Doru
summary: Father Donavich's son, who became a vampire.

facts.text: Recruited a party to clear the castle and was said to have woken Strahd.
Returned as a vampire, took the holy symbol, and was staked beneath the church.
His body dissolved in a stream.
Blackmailed Van Richten into leading a revolt on the castle.

name: Kreza
summary: A Barovia village scout searching for the Landston family.

facts.text: Met on the trail to Tser Pool with fellow scout Conga.

name: Conga
summary: A Barovia village scout searching for the Landston family.

facts.text: Met on the trail to Tser Pool with fellow scout Kreza.

name: Landston family
summary: A missing family of two parents and five children from Barovia village.

facts.text: Scouts were searching for them; the party fought and killed figures by an ancient oak believed to be them.

name: Madam Eva
summary: An old Vistani seer at Tser Pool who reads fortunes.

facts.text: Appeared in the party's dreams and asked them to seek her at Tser Pool.
Read the party's fortune with five cards.
Once had a pet raven named Turo.
Asked Aera to buy a toy for her grandchild Arabelle.
Warned Van Richten not to return to the village.

name: Turo
summary: Madam Eva's former pet raven.

facts.text: Madam Eva said the party's bird companion reminded her of him.

name: Stanimir
summary: A Vistani man at the Tser Pool camp.

facts.text: Welcomed the party and told a tale of a prince turned tyrant.
Told the true story of Arturi's curse.

name: Eliza
summary: A woman at the Tser Pool camp curious about the party.

facts.text: Asked many questions; Malron feared she served the shadow.
Told a tale of ravens and a Holy Symbol of Raven Kind.

name: Arturi Vedonavich
summary: A cursed Vistani-looking visitor searching for Van Richten.

facts.text: Claimed to know Rudolph van Richten.
Left the camp at night and was found in a tree surrounded by 12 zombies.

name: Rudolph van Richten
summary: A vampire hunter and scholar disguised in Vallaki as the carnival showman Rictavio.

facts.text: A chest carved 'R V Richten' held silver bolts and holy water.
Wrote 'A Study of the Werewolf's Curse'.
As Rictavio, claimed to be an agent of the Keepers of the Feather.
A journal in the Tower of Khazan revealed Rictavio is Van Richten.
Rescued Arabelle and hid her in his wagon.
Gave Malron the Talisman of Echoes.

name: Morgantha
summary: A fiend who sells dream pastries from the windmill with her daughters.

facts.text: Sold her cart to Aera and warned that Vallaki guards take silver.
Vallaki guards warned to be careful what you tell her.

name: Bella
summary: One of Morgantha's daughters.

facts.text: Lives at the windmill with Morgantha.

name: Offalia
summary: One of Morgantha's daughters.

facts.text: Lives at the windmill with Morgantha.

name: Sir Godfrey Gwilym
summary: A revenant knight guarding the Tser Falls bridge.

facts.text: Claims to be a Knight of the Order of the Silver Dragon banished by Vladimir Horngaard.

name: Vladimir Horngaard
summary: Commander who banished Sir Godfrey Gwilym.

facts.text: Named as Sir Godfrey Gwilym's commander.

name: Skeletal Rider
summary: A skeletal rider on a war horse that emerges from the mists.

facts.text: Encountered on the path out of the Vistani camp.
Wears chain mail and holds a lantern that sheds no light; the party followed it south then turned back.

name: Izek Strazni
summary: A Vallaki guard who serves the Baron.

facts.text: Summoned fire to drive refugees from the gate.
Led a procession with the Baron and pushed an old woman into the mud.
Records say his younger sister was Ireena Strazni.

name: Ireena Strazni
summary: Izek's younger sister, recorded as dead at age four.

facts.text: Records say she died over eighteen years ago, presumed devoured by wolves.

name: Grygori Strazni
summary: Father of Izek and Ireena Strazni.

facts.text: Recorded as dying by hanging soon after his daughter.

name: Fatima Strazni
summary: Mother of Izek and Ireena Strazni.

facts.text: Recorded as dying by hanging soon after her daughter.

name: Baron of Vallaki
summary: The harsh ruler of Vallaki.

facts.text: Refused to come out to the refugees; led a procession with Izek.
Said a malevolent spirit plagues his mansion.

name: Victor
summary: The Baron's son, a secretive student of magic.

facts.text: Appeared invisible in the library; his spellbook bore the ring's symbol.
Studies necromancy and is curious about Khazan's tower.
Has a teleportation circle in the attic.

name: Urwin
summary: A man at the Blue Water Inn bar, married to Danika.

facts.text: Welcomed the party into the inn.

name: Danika
summary: Runs the Blue Water Inn.

facts.text: Runs the inn and is married to Urwin.
Told the party Rictavio was at his yellow wagon.

name: Karl
summary: A man at the Blue Water Inn who opposes the Baron.

facts.text: Pranked with a stuffed bat at the inn; against the Baron along with Nikolai.

name: Nikolai
summary: A man at the Blue Water Inn who opposes the Baron.

facts.text: Pranked with a stuffed bat at the inn; against the Baron along with Karl.

name: Brom
summary: A boy at the Blue Water Inn.

facts.text: Noted along with Bray for having good masks.

name: Bray
summary: A boy at the Blue Water Inn.

facts.text: Noted along with Brom for having good masks.

name: Udo
summary: A Vallaki man imprisoned by the Baron.

facts.text: Imprisoned; his mother was also taken to the stocks.

name: Blinsky
summary: Toymaker who runs Blinsky's Toy Store in Vallaki.

facts.text: Whispered of a clockwork creation in Castle Ravenloft.

name: Arabelle
summary: Madam Eva's young Vistani grandchild, kidnapped and then hidden by Van Richten.

facts.text: Madam Eva wanted a toy bought for her.
Went missing; her father Alexi offered 500 gold for her safe return.
Van Richten rescued her from a sack and hid her in his wagon.
Delivered a prophecy to the party.

name: Alexi
summary: A Vistani at the Vallaki encampment, Arabelle's father.

facts.text: Was drugged by Yann and offered 500 gold to recover Arabelle alive.

name: Yann
summary: A Vistani accused of kidnapping Arabelle.

facts.text: Drugged Alexi and was found beheaded near the Luna River.
His head was questioned with the Talisman of Echoes.

name: Kasimir
summary: A Dusk Elf mage and scribe who held a sigil-bearing signet ring.

facts.text: Held the signet ring and told the history of the Dusk Elves.
Was a mage and scribe in his uncle Erevan's court.

name: Rahadin
summary: Kasimir's cousin who betrayed the elves to King Barov.

facts.text: Shattered Erevan's blade and executed his family.

name: King Barov von Zarovich II
summary: Strahd's father, who conquered the elves of Othrondil.

facts.text: Demanded fealty from the elves and conquered them when refused.

name: Erevan Löwenhart
summary: Kasimir's uncle and leader of the elven council of princes, a bladesong master.

facts.text: Refused King Barov's demand for fealty and was killed by Rahadin.

name: Khazan
summary: The original mage tied to the ring's symbol and the Tower of Khazan.

facts.text: The ring's symbol connects to him.
His name is on the red seal of the tower door.

name: Szoldar
summary: A guide who led the party toward the Tower of Khazan.

facts.text: Lives in a shack with his brother Yevgeni and sold Aera a glamour weave pelt.
Returned to his hut afterward.

name: Yevgeni
summary: Szoldar's brother.

facts.text: Met in the shack with Szoldar.

name: Ezmerelda d'Avenir
summary: Van Richten's former apprentice, whose wagon sits at the Tower of Khazan.

facts.text: A sign at the tower names it her home and property.
Her trapped wagon held weapons, kits and spell scrolls.
Van Richten's former apprentice; her amulet went to Arabelle.

name: Zollst
summary: A trapper and werewolf.

facts.text: With Matilda, warned of a bloodthirsty lady, then turned into a werewolf and was defeated.

name: Matilda
summary: A trapper and werewolf.

facts.text: With Zollst, turned into a werewolf and was defeated.

name: Escher
summary: A golden-haired vampire spawn, once a Barovian bard and Doru's lieutenant.

facts.text: Received a kidnapped Arabelle and was scarred by Van Richten.
Betrayed the revolt by vanishing in the castle catacombs.

name: Drusilla
summary: Van Richten's horse.

facts.text: Hidden at the tower at Lake Baratok.

name: Arrigal
summary: A Vistani who tailed the party and disagrees with Van Richten about Arabelle.

facts.text: Revealed himself after tailing the party; cleared of the plot to abduct Arabelle.

name: Henrik
summary: A man delivering church repair materials in Vallaki.

facts.text: Met delivering materials to St. Andral's Church.

name: Milivoj
summary: A worker repairing St. Andral's Church, suspected in the bone theft.

facts.text: Has black hair and a gray cloak, making him the prime suspect.

name: Father Lucian
summary: The priest of St. Andral's Church in Vallaki.

facts.text: Offered Ireena permanent shelter; the church's warding bones were stolen.

name: Yeska
summary: A boy working at St. Andral's Church.

facts.text: Knew of the bones' protection and ritual, so the priest suspects him.

name: Daggerford
summary: The town where the party first met.

facts.text: The party sheltered in a barn here before the mists took them.
Nowhere in sight from the manor balcony.

name: Durst Manor
summary: The haunted four-story home of the Durst family.

facts.text: The party found it after walking through the mists.
A blood message warned of a beast beneath the house.
A hidden stair led to a cult dungeon below.
Collapsed into the ground after Walter was destroyed.

name: Durst Mill
summary: The Durst family's mill.

facts.text: An invitation celebrated its one-year anniversary.

name: Wizard of Wines Winery
summary: A winery whose wine was found in Durst Manor.

facts.text: A bottle of its wine was hidden in a teapot.

name: Barovia
summary: Both the land ruled by Strahd and the village beneath his castle.

facts.text: The village was recently besieged by Strahd's forces.
Shop prices were five times standard for the party.
Strahd named the valley Barovia after claiming it.

name: Blood on the Vine Tavern
summary: A tavern in Barovia village.

facts.text: Recently renamed; where the party met Ismark.

name: Castle Ravenloft
summary: Strahd's stone castle high above Barovia village.

facts.text: Seen above the village before the fog covered it.
A procession of souls went into it from the graveyard.
Reached by the east fork of the road.
Blinsky spoke of a clockwork creation within.

name: Vallaki
summary: A walled town west of Barovia village ruled by a harsh Baron.

facts.text: Some villagers fled here.
Guards charge a gold toll and confiscate silver; refugees camp outside.
Preparing for the Festival of the Blazing Sun.

name: Church of Saint Andral
summary: A church in Vallaki and possible sanctuary for Ireena.

facts.text: Ismark suggested it as a sanctuary.
Hallowed by bones in its crypt that were recently stolen.

name: Abbey of Saint Markovia
summary: An abbey in Krezk near the mists.

facts.text: Ismark asked the party to escort Ireena here.
Madam Eva's Mists card points to a Vistana found here.

name: Krezk
summary: A place where the Abbey of Saint Markovia stands.

facts.text: Home of the Abbey of Saint Markovia.

name: Tser Pool
summary: A lake west of Barovia village where Madam Eva's Vistani camp sits.

facts.text: Madam Eva said her tent was here.
Two hours west of Barovia village.
The party had their fortunes read at the camp.

name: Blue Water Inn
summary: An inn in Vallaki run by Danika.

facts.text: Recommended by the guards; the party rented rooms there.
Where the party confronted Rictavio.

name: Blinsky's Toy Store
summary: A toy shop in Vallaki.

facts.text: Madam Eva sent coins to buy something there.
Had a doll resembling Ireena.

name: Baron's Mansion
summary: The Baron of Vallaki's home, haunted by a spirit.

facts.text: The party entered claiming an appointment to see the library.
Its attic hides a teleportation circle.

name: Luna River
summary: A river near Vallaki.

facts.text: Yann's head lay toward it.
Van Richten saw Arabelle handed to Escher on its banks.

name: Tower of Khazan
summary: A tower by Lake Baratok tied to the mage Khazan.

facts.text: Victor was curious about it.
Opened with the signet ring pattern.
Its top floor held signs of recent living and a journal.
Has a permanent antimagic field.

name: Lake Baratok
summary: A lake with the tower where Van Richten hid.

facts.text: Van Richten laid low in the tower here.

name: Othrondil
summary: The former home of the Dusk Elves.

facts.text: Conquered by King Barov's forces.

name: Vistani
summary: Traveling people of Barovia with camps near Tser Pool and Vallaki.

facts.text: Three Vistani were at the Blood on the Vine; Ismark warned some spy for Strahd.
Their camp at Tser Pool hosted the party.
Sheltered the Dusk Elves from Strahd.

name: Dusk Elves
summary: Elves who have lived in Barovia for five centuries under Vistani protection.

facts.text: Survived Strahd's genocide and were led to the valley by the Vistani.

name: Keepers of the Feather
summary: A secret society against Strahd.

facts.text: Rictavio claimed to be their secret agent.

name: Order of the Silver Dragon
summary: A knightly order.

facts.text: Sir Godfrey Gwilym claims to be one of its knights.

name: Morninglord
summary: The god of Father Donavich's church.

facts.text: The Bronze Sunburst is his holy symbol.
Malron and Father Donavich agree he is Lathander by another name.

name: Lathander
summary: The Lord of Birth and Renewal, Malron's god.

facts.text: Malron wonders if the Morninglord is the same god.

name: Mother Night
summary: A power named in Madam Eva's reading.

facts.text: The Myrmidon card's treasure belongs to her.

name: Ladies Three
summary: Figures honored on an ancient monument.

facts.text: Honored with the Seeker on a stone slab with a star and raven.
Honored with the Dreamer on an ancient monument.

name: Dark Powers
summary: Powers of Barovia mentioned in Strahd's letter.

facts.text: Strahd denies being a messiah sent by them.

name: Amber shard
summary: An amber shard meant to soothe the Beast beneath Durst Manor.

facts.text: Elisabeth's amber shard flashed in the ballroom vision.
Found in a silver jewelry box with a note to Drasha.
Malron held it up calling Walter's name, with no effect.

name: Bronze Sunburst
summary: Father Donavich's holy symbol of the Morninglord.

facts.text: Taken by vampire Doru.
Returned to Father Donavich by Schlopkht.

name: Holy Symbol of Raven Kind
summary: A holy symbol mentioned in Eliza's tale.

facts.text: Seemed a key element of Eliza's raven story.

name: Sword of Sunlight
summary: A weapon of vengeance named in Madam Eva's reading.

facts.text: The Bishop card says it lies in treasure beyond amber doors.

name: A Study of the Werewolf's Curse
summary: A manuscript on werewolves by Van Richten.

facts.text: Won by Grom and read aloud by Olfin.

name: Dream Pastries
summary: Sleep-inducing pies sold by Morgantha.

facts.text: A cat slept five hours after eating one; one put a wolf out of a fight.
A quarter of the refugees are addicted to them.

name: Signet ring
summary: A sigil-bearing ring linked to Khazan.

facts.text: Kasimir held it; its design mixed necromancy and evocation.
Its symbol matched Victor's spellbook.
Its pattern unlocked the Tower of Khazan.

name: Staff of Khazan
summary: A legendary staff the party sought in the Tower of Khazan.

facts.text: Szoldar was to guide the party to the tower holding it.

name: Talisman of Echoes
summary: A talisman with four charges for asking the dead questions.

facts.text: Van Richten used it on a Vistana's head, then gave it to Malron.

name: Amulet of proof against detection and location
summary: An amulet that hides its wearer, once Ezmerelda's.

facts.text: Van Richten gave a spare to Arabelle.

name: Hat of disguise
summary: Van Richten's disguise hat.

facts.text: Used to sneak into the Vistani camp in a dead man's guise.

name: Glamour weave pelt
summary: A wolf pelt made of rare magical glamour weave.

facts.text: Aera bought it from Szoldar for 50 gold.

name: Tale of Malron
summary: A book in Durst Manor telling Malron's life story.

facts.text: Its ending described him being watched by an evil presence.

name: Waltz for Kara
summary: Sheet music hidden in the Durst Manor harpsichord.

facts.text: Playing it summoned dancing apparitions.

name: Rictavio's Carnival of Wonders
summary: Van Richten's disguised wagon where Arabelle hides.

facts.text: Painted with stolen Vistani paint and enchanted to seem undesirable.
